front.title: Post-Quantum Cryptographic Key Provenance Evidence for RATS

abstract.t: This document defines CBOR claims for attesting the provenance of post-quantum cryptographic (PQC) keys (ML-KEM, ML-DSA, SLH-DSA), including the originating Hardware Security Module (HSM) or Trusted Execution Environment (TEE) generation context, a hybrid-pairing proof for hybrid certificate chains, and a rotation_epoch_id binding.

The claims enable a verifier to establish that a PQC key was generated within a trusted boundary and was not migrated from a classical key. The evidence schema is intentionally minimal; policy decisions made by the verifier are out of scope and are not disclosed in this Internet-Draft.

section.name: Introduction
section.t: As deployments adopt PQC, relying parties need cryptographic evidence that a PQC key was generated within an attested trusted boundary rather than imported from a vulnerable classical context. This document defines such evidence claims for the RATS architecture.

section.name: Terminology
section.t: The key words "MUST", "MUST NOT", "SHOULD", "MAY" in this document are to be interpreted as described in BCP 14 [RFC2119] [RFC8174] when, and only when, they appear in all capitals, as shown here.

section.name: Evidence Claims
section.t: The pqc_key_provenance claim is a CBOR map containing trusted-environment identifier, generation timestamp, algorithm identifier, hybrid_pair_proof, and rotation_epoch_id fields. All fields except hybrid_pair_proof MUST be present.

section.name: Hybrid Pair Proof
section.t: When the attested key is part of a hybrid pair, the hybrid_pair_proof field carries a signature or commitment binding the PQC key to its classical companion. The concrete cryptographic construction is defined in Section 5.

section.name: Verifier Policy
section.t: Verifier policy decisions, including acceptable trusted environments, minimum rotation_epoch_id values, and hybrid-pair freshness windows, are deployment-specific and are not disclosed in this Internet-Draft.

section.name: Security Considerations
section.t: The evidence schema does not carry private-key material. Verifiers MUST validate the attestation chain to the trusted environment and MUST reject claims with unbound or stale rotation_epoch_id values.

section.name: IANA Considerations
section.t: IANA is requested to allocate CBOR claim keys for pqc_key_provenance and its sub-fields in the appropriate RATS claim registry.
